cuts.ofreeRecent: a present-day outdoor orchard picnic clearing on a sunny hillside — taking a first bite of a peach after a long walk; a medieval tavern — seated on a chair; a bridal room — holds a small bouquet in both hands at her waist; a hydroponic garden dome aboard a starship — standing; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — lying on her front; a present-day seaside arcade with a glass prize-claw machine filled with folded plush stars — using the claw-machine joystick with a sharpshooter’s patience; a lantern-lit old-town street at night — standing; an indoor climbing wall of coloured holds — kneeling on the ground; a wooden sauna and cold plunge with a cooling lounge — holds one end of a towel hung around her neck; a walled garden with a lotus pond — seated sideways on a stool or bench; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — standing; the open deck of a wooden sightseeing boat on the Yangtze — standing; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — standing
